summary: Serve advisory remaining-duration estimates on client-v0 mission runs

replay.detail: ETA reads existing mission definitions, run and step states, and accepted timing edges. No new claims or replay semantics.

schema.detail: MissionRunSummary gains optional nullable eta with integer remaining_low_ms, remaining_high_ms and Unix-millisecond as_of, plus basis method and sample count. Serving uses the derived local sample projection.

rules.detail: Checkpoint, retention, fleet and execution authority rules are unchanged. Estimates do not affect scheduling or timeouts.

compatibility.detail: Published mission cards and detail reads serve ETA for open runs using the current definition hash and step paths. Durations exclude person-held time, include queueing and agent waits, and use declared dependency critical paths when present. No remaining steps yields zero durations and samples zero. Missing samples and finished runs return null; older daemons omit eta and older clients may ignore it.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon replacement enables the additional projection field; no migration or service interruption is required.

manual.detail: No configuration or operator action. Clients may display waiting on you instead of an estimate during a person hold.

recovery.detail: Estimates are reconstructed by the derived sample projection after replay. Reverting serving omits the additive field without changing claims.
